messages:
ana_customer: Hey team — since last model rollout our /generate structured_output calls intermittently return a 500 and the body is flagged as invalid JSON by our consumer. Happening for ~5% of requests.
micah_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the raw response body (or a redacted example)? also which model + json_mode are you using?
ana_customer: using redwood/gpt-4o-instruct-v1 + json_mode=structured_output. Example body attached from client: 
```
{"result": {"items": [ {"id": "a1", "value": "foo",}, {"id":"a2","value":"bar"} ]}}
```
anacustomer: note the trailing comma after "foo" — our parser chokes with a strict JSON error. This started after the rollout ~2h ago.
micah_support: thanks — that trailing comma explains the parse fail. Can you confirm you see this from our API response and not your client post-processing? any chance your SDK is mutating?
darren_eng: pinging eng-ml / eng-runtime. Quick note: our streaming formatter is supposed to emit strict JSON when json_mode=structured_output. attaching recent logs from the runtime showing one of the chunks: 
```
CHUNK 0: {"result": {"items": [
CHUNK 1: {"id": "a1", "value": "foo",}
CHUNK 2: {"id":"a2","value":"bar"} ]}}
```
darren_eng: looks like a generator token boundary inserted a comma after the value then closed the array — invalid. could be quantization-induced tokenization splitting or formatting template bug.
lee_runtime: grabbing traces now. do we have request ids for a repro? ana — can you share request_id / short trace id from your SDK?
ana_customer: yes, request_id=req_20260312_9f3b. Happened twice more: req_20260312_9f4c and req_20260312_9f9d. I can forward the full raw HTTP bodies.
micah_support: got them, thanks. I see the same trailing commas. Quick workaround: set json_mode=plain_text for now or run a tolerant parser on consumer side that allows trailing commas. We'll escalate to eng to fix generator.
darren_eng: thanks — reproducing locally now. hypothesis: during streaming the template prints list items with "," suffix unconditionally and relies on generator to omit it for last item; tokenization race can cause extra comma to be emitted then the generator emits close bracket. fix options: 1) change template so generator emits separators deterministically (no post-hoc comma), 2) post-stream sanitizer that drops dangling commas before final parse, or 3) make structured_output enforce chunk-level well-formedness.
lee_runtime: also checking if this affects schema validation layer (pydantic/jsonschema). if we get malformed json the validator throws a parse error. Error from client: 
```
pydantic.json_schema.JsonSchemaValueError: JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 27 (char 26)
```
micah_support: can you confirm whether this caused any billing or auth anomalies? customers sometimes see retries inflate usage.
nana_customer: we saw an uptick in 500 retries from our side; billing looks slightly higher but within noise. No auth failures.
darren_eng: root cause narrowed to streaming buffer boundary combined with comma-in-template. I'll push a patch to stop emitting separators in the template and instead prefix items with "," from the second item (safer). PR coming in ~30m.
micah_support: thanks. ETA for rollout? any temp mitigation for customers who cannot change client parsing?
darren_eng: will deploy fix to staging in 15m, prod after smoke tests in ~45m. Temp mitigation: add tolerant parser on client or set json_mode=plain_text. We can also offer an express route to route affected org to a fixed instance if they need immediate stable responses — @lee_runtime can confirm capacity.
lee_runtime: we can apply a hotfix route for the org if they want immediate mitigation; need org id and approval.
nana_customer: please do the hotfix route for org_772 — we need stable output for our nightly batch. Appreciate the quick triage. :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: patch/streaming-comma-fix -> staging (darren_eng)
micah_support: I'll follow up after prod rollout. if anyone on the customer side sees a different malformed pattern please paste an example. :eyes:
